description: Manages git configuration values. Supports get, set, list, and unset actions. Operates at local, global, system, or worktree scope.

key.description: Config key (required for get, set, unset)

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

scope.description: Config scope (default: effective scope for get/list, local for set)

name: config
title: Git Config
